info.title: Melostore H2H Public API
info.description: Public partner API. Two authentication headers are required together unless an operation explicitly has security=[]. Fictional order creation examples set sandbox_mode=true; omitted/null mode uses the account setting. Enter the Webhook URL in the dashboard. Rotate Keys generates the API Key, Secret Key, and Webhook Secret together and shows them once; later rotations replace all three immediately. Update API credentials and the webhook receiver secret after rotation.

get.description: Brands represented in the regular catalogue for your tier. Each record contains brand_id, name, slug, its parent category, and direct child product types in type[]. Sorted by parent category ID ascending, then brand name A-Z; brands without a parent category appear last. Use brand_id in the catalogue query or slug in /pricelists/{category_slug}. A listed brand or type does not guarantee an active SKU; check the matching pricelist.
get.x-description-id: Brand yang memiliki produk pada katalog reguler tier Anda. Setiap record berisi brand_id, name, slug, kategori induk pada category, serta tipe produk anak langsung pada type[]. Urutan berdasarkan ID kategori induk naik, lalu nama brand A-Z; brand tanpa kategori induk di akhir. Gunakan brand_id sebagai filter katalog atau slug pada /pricelists/{category_slug}. Brand atau tipe yang terdaftar tidak menjamin SKU aktif; periksa daftar harga terkait.

post.description: Create one regular order using an exact regular sku_code. HTTP 201 acknowledges receipt; read data.status for fulfillment. Repeat the same request with the same buyer_trx_id if the response is uncertain. Use a new reference for a new order. Optional max_price sets your maximum final charge and the full limit is held upfront. Unused hold is refunded on success; failed orders receive a full refund.
post.x-description-id: Buat satu pesanan memakai sku_code reguler. HTTP 201 berarti pesanan diterima; baca data.status untuk hasilnya. Jika respons belum pasti, ulangi request yang sama dengan buyer_trx_id yang sama. Gunakan referensi baru untuk pesanan baru. max_price opsional membatasi biaya akhir dan seluruh batas ditahan di awal. Sisa saldo dikembalikan saat sukses; pesanan gagal mendapat refund penuh.

get.description: Look up your transaction by UUID or buyer_trx_id. Supports regular, Smart and individual bulk orders; use billing.transaction_id for paid account checks. Match Smart results using id/buyer_trx_id, as sku_code may differ from the ordered SKU. fulfilled_sku_code identifies the successfully fulfilled SKU. Account-check buyer_trx_id, sku_code and serial_number are null. Smart/bulk fields appear only for their order type.
get.x-description-id: Cari transaksi Anda melalui UUID atau buyer_trx_id. Berlaku untuk reguler, Smart, dan setiap pesanan bulk; gunakan billing.transaction_id untuk pemeriksaan akun berbayar. Cocokkan hasil Smart melalui id/buyer_trx_id karena sku_code dapat berbeda dari SKU yang dipesan. fulfilled_sku_code menunjukkan SKU yang berhasil dipenuhi. buyer_trx_id, sku_code, dan serial_number pemeriksaan akun bernilai null. Field Smart/bulk hanya muncul sesuai jenis pesanan.

post.description: Submit a requested code for manual admin handling, for regular or Smart orders. Requires X-API-Key and X-Secret-Key and the existing IP whitelist. Limit: 5 requests/minute per owner and transaction. HTTP 202 confirms receipt, not validity. Trim code to 1–128 characters without control characters. Retry the same code if delivery is uncertain; a different code is rejected until a new request. This endpoint never creates an order or changes transaction/financial status.
post.x-description-id: Kirim kode yang diminta untuk penanganan admin pada transaksi reguler atau Smart. Gunakan X-API-Key, X-Secret-Key, dan IP whitelist yang berlaku. Batas 5 permintaan/menit per pemilik dan transaksi. HTTP 202 berarti diterima, bukan terbukti valid. Ulangi kode yang sama jika respons belum diterima; kode berbeda ditolak sampai permintaan baru. Status transaksi dan keuangan tidak berubah.

post.summary: Per-transaction result sent to partner-configured webhook URL
post.description: Final results for API orders and individual bulk orders. Verify raw-body HMAC-SHA256 using Webhook Secret, save events durably before returning 2xx, and deduplicate repeated deliveries. Action events can arrive while processing; they do not finalize an order. Final callback delivery uses up to three attempts with retry delays of 30 and 120 seconds; delivery may be later. Respond within 10 seconds. If delivery fails, check transaction status. Dashboard orders do not send partner callbacks.
